name: Alarm Tap
description: While an alarm rings, a black screen shows the time, a big snooze label with the snooze count and a hint. A tap or a hardware key runs one action (for example snooze), a double tap or a second key press another (for example stop). The plugin counts the snoozes, can limit them and can speak a text for each step, with the snooze count in it.
author: d3rb3rt

settings.title: Alarm ringing entity
settings.description: A binary sensor that is on while the alarm rings, such as the kiosk's Alarm ringing sensor.

settings.title: Snooze label
settings.description: The big text on the ringing screen.

settings.title: Show the time
settings.description: Shows the current time above the snooze label.

settings.title: Tap action
settings.description: Runs on a single tap while the alarm rings, for example a script that snoozes.

settings.title: Double tap action
settings.description: Runs on a double tap while the alarm rings, for example a script that stops it.

settings.title: Snooze length
settings.description: Length of one snooze as set in Kiosk Satellite. Used for {total} and {length} in the texts and to know how long the alarm stays snoozed.

settings.title: Maximum snoozes
settings.description: 0 means unlimited. Once this many snoozes are used, a tap runs the limit action instead of the tap action.

settings.title: New alarm after
settings.description: The count starts again when the alarm rings after a pause longer than this.

settings.title: Double tap window
settings.description: A single tap runs after this wait, unless a second tap follows within it.

settings.title: Snooze keys
settings.description: Keys that snooze while the alarm rings, comma-separated Android key names without KEYCODE_. A key listed here and under Stop keys snoozes on the first press and stops on a second press within the window. Empty means no key snoozes.

settings.title: Stop keys
settings.description: Keys that stop the alarm, also while it is snoozed. A key that is only a stop key stops on the first press. Empty means no key stops. Turn on Kiosk Satellite's option to swallow the volume keys if they should not change the volume.

settings.title: Second key press window
settings.description: For a key that both snoozes and stops: a second press within this time stops the alarm. For a snooze-only key, a second press within this time is ignored.

settings.title: Hint text
settings.description: Shown below the snooze label while the alarm rings. Leave empty for no hint.

settings.title: Speak service
settings.description: Home Assistant service that speaks, written as domain.service, for example tts.speak. Empty means no speech.

settings.title: Extra service data (JSON)
settings.description: Further fields the service needs besides the text, as JSON. The text is sent as "message". Example for tts.speak: {"entity_id": "tts.home_assistant_cloud", "media_player_entity_id": "media_player.clock"}.

settings.title: Text on tap
settings.description: Spoken when a tap or key snoozes. Empty means silence. Placeholders: {n} = number of this snooze, {total} = total snooze minutes so far ({n} × Snooze length), {length} = minutes of one snooze, {max} = Maximum snoozes.

settings.title: Volume of the snooze announcement
settings.description: Sent to the speak service as the field volume (0 to 1). 0 sends no volume, for services that have none, such as tts.speak.

settings.title: Text on double tap
settings.description: Spoken when the alarm is stopped. Empty means silence. Placeholders: {n} = number of this snooze, {total} = total snooze minutes so far ({n} × Snooze length), {length} = minutes of one snooze, {max} = Maximum snoozes.

settings.title: Volume of the end of alarm announcement
settings.description: Sent to the speak service as the field volume (0 to 1). 0 sends no volume, for services that have none, such as tts.speak.

settings.title: Text at the limit
settings.description: Spoken when a snooze is refused because the maximum is reached. Empty means silence. Placeholders: {n} = number of this snooze, {total} = total snooze minutes so far ({n} × Snooze length), {length} = minutes of one snooze, {max} = Maximum snoozes.

settings.title: Volume of the limit announcement
settings.description: Sent to the speak service as the field volume (0 to 1). 0 sends no volume, for services that have none, such as tts.speak.
